scope: All OffPageConnector and Global power/ground objects on every page; all existing connector instances before/after design changes

checker_facts_format.vectors: tip_vector from actual transformed contour; circuit_vector from actual owning wire/circuit geometry in same coordinate frame
checker_facts_format.global_role_policy: Every Global is classified ground or power. Native name GND always forces GNDORDER even if is_ground=false; contradictory roles fail. Unclassified Global cannot pass. Every power Global requires POWERGAP; unsupported non-circle marker remains unknown.

check_definitions.EPINV: Every actual endpoint is inventoried exactly once and tied to final native/source identity; omissions/duplicates are not passes
check_definitions.EPTYPE: Correct real native OffPageConnector/Global kind, name, scope and approved library/symbol identity
check_definitions.EPNAME: OffPage/power own effective visible complete Name; no Alias/text substitution; ground follows calibrated native name-display profile
check_definitions.EPHOTSPOT: Transformed real native hotspot connects to the intended owning wire endpoint and net
check_definitions.EPDIR: Actual transformed OffPage contour points into its circuit; power/ground contour orientation matches approved native profile and local topology
check_definitions.EPOUTSIDE: Visible own Name is fully outside in the calibrated native display frame; not a line-internal Alias
check_definitions.EPCLEAR: Complete symbol contour, actual full text glyphs and dense neighboring scene are covered and readable without collisions
check_definitions.EPTOPO: Reasonable pre-existing bus/decoupling/vertical power branches and actual junctions preserved or changes explicitly authorized
check_definitions.EPGRID: Actual hotspot, required wire points and display anchors compatible with this project's measured grid/profile
check_definitions.EPREOPEN: After last visual edit native save, close, independent reopen and fresh export; electrical comparison and full-scene display evidence bind final identity
check_definitions.CONNKEEP: All frozen existing connector instances/refdes including extra/reserved/unused remain in final deliverable unless specific user removal permission is recorded
check_definitions.GNDORDER: Compute complete transformed native bar ink lengths from endpoints/stroke widths, sort centers from actual circuit toward free space, require centered parallel bars perpendicular to that axis and strictly decreasing lengths; native bar count is not fixed to three.
check_definitions.POWERGAP: Compute actual circle outer ink to nearest complete own-Name ink edge on the native wire outward axis; require tight outside gap within calibrated positive-reference maximum plus native quantization, and recompute reference gaps so an arbitrary upper bound cannot pass.

ground_Global.bar_count: Exact independent native inventory, at least two; do not assume three
ground_Global.near_to_far: Maximum bar nearest circuit, all remaining bars progressively shorter toward free space; left/right mirror by actual circuit direction

ground_name_policy.if_visible: Own native Global Name; complete text outside; never Alias substitution

approved_reference_assets.relationship: 右端真实翻页符：尖头向内，Name在外侧；内部GPIO标签不替代端部Name。
左端翻页名称在线内，GND旋转后密集重叠；不能只检查锚点在线。
电源呈现为横线端部圆点和线内名称；隐藏Global Name再用Alias标名不合格。
电源母线向上的短竖支路，真实Global在外端，完整Name在上方空白区；保留合理拓扑。

release_rule: Every inventoried endpoint and applicable check needs bound evidence, including GNDORDER for all native GND objects and POWERGAP for every power Global. Missing/uncalibrated/unsupported means unknown; conflict means fail. ENDPOINT-20261116.1 facts/reports without new geometry cannot be inherited as new checks PASS. Limited facts PASS is not full-scene, compact-layout, electrical, GUI or PCB acceptance.

geometry_binding_schema.source_xml_sha256: Must equal top native_source_sha256; checker hashes readable native_source file to verify that identity
geometry_binding_schema.native_export_sha256: SHA256 of final native geometry evidence; extractor identity/accuracy is audited separately
geometry_binding_schema.symbol_geometry_sha256: SHA256 of complete native symbol geometry, including all relevant primitives

ground_geometry_schema.native_bar_ids: Complete independently enumerated native cache bar IDs; count >=2, exact one-to-one coverage by bars; all IDs unique

bars_item.stroke_width_doc: Resolved actual rendered line width >=0; ink length = endpoint distance + line width

ground_geometry_schema.quantization_doc: Measured native coordinate/geometry quantization, 0 <= value <1 document unit; not an adjustable clearance or direction tolerance
algorithm: all bars must be perpendicular to outward within native quantization
project actual bar centers onto outward; sort increasing
centers must share the same lateral axis
each next center is farther outward and its ink length is strictly smaller than the previous by more than quantization
fails: equal or increasing outward bar lengths
missing/duplicate/extra primitive IDs relative to independent inventory
unknown: missing complete native bar inventory or endpoints/stroke width
ground_geometry_schema.important: No fixed three-bar assumption. No text ground and profile_verified=true still require this computation.

circle.axis_b: Second transformed radius basis vector, perpendicular and same length

power_geometry_schema.Name_ink_input: object.text_bounds is actual complete own-Name glyph ink [min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y], not anchor, character count or stale cache bbox
power_geometry_schema.document_units: Native document unit identity; must match calibration profile
power_geometry_schema.font_signature: Actual resolved Name font identity/signature; must match calibration profile

gap_profile.approved_reference_id: Identifier of genuinely user-approved native positive reference; user approval is independently audited
gap_profile.max_gap_doc: Explicit calibrated upper bound; must agree with maximum gap recomputed from all supplied approved native reference samples within quantization
gap_profile.quantization_doc: Native measurement quantization 0 <= value <1 document unit; not a free layout gap

circle.axis_b: Second transformed radius basis vector, perpendicular and same length

reference_samples_item.name_ink_bounds: Actual complete positive-reference own-Name glyph ink bounds
reference_samples_item.circuit_vector: Actual native reference wire direction from endpoint into circuit

algorithm: actual_circle_outer_support = center dot outward + hypot(axis_a dot outward, axis_b dot outward) + stroke_width/2
Name_near_support = minimum outward projection of actual full Name ink bounds
recompute reference gaps by the same method; reject an upper bound inconsistent with those reference geometries

also require perpendicular separation of Name ink interval from circle center not exceed maximum approved reference separation plus quantization; a Name far above/below cannot pass from a small axial gap alone
power_geometry_schema.supported_axes: Horizontal/vertical actual native wire ends; unsupported circle/Name frames or other power marker families remain unknown
fails: Name outside but too far from circle
Name overlaps circle beyond native quantization
calibrated maximum inflated beyond actual approved native reference geometry
Name far perpendicular to wire axis despite small axial gap
unknown: missing actual circle or full Name ink
power_geometry_schema.no_pixel_inference: Do not invent document-unit limits from screenshot pixels. Calibrate approved native instances first.

additional_user_corrections_20261116.ground: Largest bar at circuit side; remaining true-library bar count progressively shorter outward; mirror left/right
additional_user_corrections_20261116.power: Own Name tightly adjacent to actual outside circle ink; outside alone is insufficient
additional_user_corrections_20261116.compactness_boundary: Functional R/C grouping, row spacing and device-to-symbol lead length require separate compact layout evidence; endpoint PASS does not certify them
additional_user_corrections_20261116.new_screenshot_publication: New correction screenshots remain only in project-local source; no new screenshots are included in this public rule update
